title: Bill Ackman, Brad Gerstner Pile Into The Same 4 Stocks – What Do They See Coming? - Amazon.com (NASDAQ:AMZN), Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOG), Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL), Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META)
summary: Shared four stocks between Ackman's and Gerstner's hedge funds, with changes in their positions in Meta, Amazon, Uber, GOOGL, and GOOGL's combined holding. Meta and Amazon saw significant changes in their stakes, while Uber remained unchanged. Gerstner hinted at Meta no longer being a top holding.
sentiment_reason: The article presents routine news about hedge fund stock holdings with some notable changes in positions, but without clear indications of strong negative or positive market impact.
